title: Illustrative summary (not official guideline text): KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes in CKD

treatment.content: Glucose-lowering therapy in CKD should prioritize renal and cardiovascular protection.
key_points: Metformin safe until eGFR <30, then discontinue
SGLT2i: Continue until eGFR <20 for renal protection
GLP-1 RA: Safe and effective across all CKD stages
Avoid sulfonylureas in advanced CKD (hypoglycemia risk)

disclaimer: Short summary written for this research prototype. It is not the official guideline text and has not been checked against it. Not medical advice.
